dent.doc: Dent (the crash-test ghost; the old gearbox soul): power_gearbox seizes the car nearest the aim point aim_m ahead of Rivet (powers.json gearbox: lock radius, range, drive speed, turn rate) and drives it where he aims. A fighter within car_reach_m of the car's centre is struck once per seize: car_damage, thrown car_knock_m along the nose (weapon dent_car: the blowback kill). The car heats over overload_s; past arm_k it blows on the next impact, on a melee press or at full heat: every fighter within blast_radius_m takes blast_damage (weapon dent_blast: the gib kill) and the car is wrecked. ride 1: Dent rides the seized car's roof (the bucking-bull vignette: Rivet's place is the car's, steered by his facing) and hops off ride_hop_m behind it as it blows; 0 keeps him standing where he seized it. Default 0 since d7-calls ghost-powers-3 (owner pick 2026-11-05: Dent steers the seized car from afar on the teal tether, Rivet clear of the blast); 1 = the old ride.

doc: Lane ghost-powers: each ghost form's attack set beyond the powers.json row (the form's timing, Madness cost and the old hauler/gearbox tuning stay there). One block per ghost (tonnage, dent, kerf, ohm), each with upgrade_tier (0 = base; the per-act quest upgrades raise it later, nothing reads above 0 yet). Metres, seconds, damage in hp (a patrol cop has 1, a riot cop 2 x the pit's armour, a robot thug 6). Anchors are body-local metres (+x = facing, +y = right) until the forms lane's form rows carry them.

kerf.doc: Kerf (the freed laser-cutter head): power row kerf (GhostPilot: G selects Kerf, Q transforms; the form row's top_mps sets the walk, speed_k is the standalone stage's). While the form is settled, the melee press blinks: the live hostile nearest the aim inside cone_deg (half-angle) and range_m, with a clear line (no wall between), is the target; Rivet blinks along the straight line to behind_m beyond it and the cutting beam slices it (weapon kerf_slice: human_damage on a human = the one-shot split kill with a teal-white cauterised edge, signature_kills.json kerf_split; robot_damage on a robot). No target in the cone: a plain blink dash_m along the aim (the speed move). Each blink spends one of charges; one comes back every recharge_s; blinks are at least gap_s apart. The cut line hangs in the air for cut_hang_s (view only). path_cut_m (the owner's call, 0 = built, target only): above 0, every other live hostile within that many metres of the blink line is sliced too (a crowd tool). cut_flare_s (view only, n7-melee): on each cut frame an ink-and-cream slash flare across the target for that long, so every cut of the chain is its own mark (0 = none; --feel=off hides it too).

ohm.doc: Ohm (the elder spot-welder, the mage): power row ohm (GhostPilot: G selects Ohm, Q transforms). While the form is settled, the melee press (every bolt_gap_s) throws a forked bolt from the electrode fingertips: the live hostile nearest the aim inside cone_deg (half-angle) and range_m is struck, then the bolt forks to up to forks more within fork_radius_m of the last one (MeleeShock.chain_path, the claw shock's walk). Each body struck is stunned stun_s (the electro gun's FightAreas stun) and takes human_damage (a human: stun and burns; the kill is the electro gun's X-ray shock in soul teal, row ohm_shock, weapon ohm_bolt) or bolt_damage x machine_k (a robot). Nothing in the cone: the car nearest the aim in the cone takes car_damage x machine_k (a car is a machine: 36 of 100, so D1, D2, then the wreck on the third bolt). upgrade_tier 1 (the act quest; data hook, the reel's --tier=1 shows it): the mass arc, up to mass_targets bodies within mass_radius_m of the first. tell_glow_m (view only, n7-melee OhmView): the fingertip charge glow's radius; after a bolt it grows back over bolt_gap_s to a white ready glint, and the fire frame flashes the tips (0 or --feel=off = the old steady sparks).

tonnage.doc: Tonnage (the walking stamping press; the old hauler soul): while the form is on Rivet takes armor_k of every hit (small arms spark off the plates). The press slam (melee press, wind-up = powers.json hauler.stomp_windup_s) lands press_ahead_m ahead of the facing: every car whose centre is within car_crush_m is flattened (wrecked outright), every live fighter within hauler.stomp_radius_m takes hauler.stomp_damage and is thrown. A human it kills within crush_m of the press head is flattened (signature_kills.json row tonnage_crush, weapon stomp); one killed farther out by the shockwave dies the standard thrown death (weapon stomp_wave); a ram kill throws the body aside (row tonnage_ram, weapon ram). slam_debris / slam_debris_s / slam_flash_s (view only, n7-melee SlamDebris): on the landing, that many ink road chips thrown out in low arcs over slam_debris_s with paper-dust puffs, and a cream flash under the head for slam_flash_s (slam_debris 0 or --feel=off = none). ram_flash_s / ram_chips (view only, n7-melee RamMarks): on each ram hit a cream burst edged in ink between the press and the body for ram_flash_s, and ram_chips paper chips flung on along the shove (ram_flash_s 0 or --feel=off = none). plate_r_m / plate_spark_ticks / plate_sparks_per_tick (view only, n7-melee PlateSparks): while the form is on an enemy round's tracer stops at plate_r_m from Rivet's spot (the plates' edge) and its first contact prints a cream glance spark edged in ink for plate_spark_ticks, with a short streak off along the bounce; at most plate_sparks_per_tick new sparks a tick (plate_spark_ticks 0 or --feel=off = none: the rounds draw through as before).
